note.question: What determines the value of deadlines from the agency-theoretic perspective?
note.overview: Deadlines are common in product development and are often felt to be too harsh—many development efforts are still worth continuing at the time of mandated termination. The paper examines the value of deadlines from the agency-theoretic perspective. The model considers a firm that pays an agent to lead product development activities.
